mapper.insert: insert into operate_log (operate_emp_id, operate_time, class_name, method_name, method_params, return_value, cost_time) values (#{operateEmpId}, #{operateTime}, #{className}, #{methodName}, #{methodParams}, #{returnValue}, #{costTime})
mapper.select: select ol.id, ol.operate_emp_id as operateEmpId, ol.operate_time as operateTime, ol.class_name as className, ol.method_name as methodName, ol.method_params as methodParams, ol.return_value as returnValue, ol.cost_time as costTime, e.name as operateEmpName from operate_log ol left join emp e on e.id = ol.operate_emp_id order by ol.operate_time desc
